commands.name: gh-linear-parse-mod
commands.description: Toggle the GitHub/Linear links band (args: add <url>, group [how], group clear, on, off, clear, reset, refresh, watch on|off, color <color> [fill])

tools.name: links_band
tools.description: Returns this session's gh-linear-parse-mod links band: the GitHub PR and Linear links newest first (the band shows PRs above Linear links) with each PR's title, author, lines added and deleted, state, CI and review status, whether it has a merge conflict, and each Linear issue's status, as last checked, the links dismissed this session, whether the band is hidden or expanded, and its color. Read-only.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Sets this session's status line at the top of the gh-linear-parse-mod links band: a short note of what you are doing or waiting on (for example "waiting on CI for #812"), under 80 characters. Replaces any earlier status; an empty or missing text clears it. Set it when the person would want to see it at a glance, and clear it when the work is done.

tools.name: group_prs
tools.description: Sets how the GitHub section of the gh-linear-parse-mod links band is grouped: a list of groups, top to bottom, each with an optional label (a divider such as "round 1" or "blocked"), an optional line of text, and optional PRs (PR links, owner/repo#N, or repo#N for a PR already in the band). A group with only a label or text is informational, such as a step between rounds. Sends the whole layout each time and replaces the last one; an empty list clears it. PRs not in any group show under "other". Use it only when the person asks you to group or order PRs (for example through /gh-linear-parse-mod group), or to keep a grouping they asked for current.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
